personal.name: Punnya
personal.headline: HR Operations & Brand Strategist
personal.tagline: Where people strategy meets brand storytelling. Bridging internal workplace culture with external brand identity.
personal.subcopy: MBA graduate specializing in Human Resources and Marketing. Practical internship experience across cooperative infrastructure, financial equities, and commercial real estate.

paragraphs: I am an enthusiastic and dedicated MBA student specializing in Human Resources and Marketing at Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering. Equipped with practical knowledge from internships in both HR operations and sales environments, I am eager to apply my academic foundation to real-world people management and brand communication challenges.

Building on my undergraduate studies in B.A. English from Sree Narayana College, I bring strong business communication, active listening, and meticulous documentation skills to the workplace. During my internships, I gained valuable hands-on exposure to HR processes at a financial brokerage (Hedge Equities) and a major cooperative society (ULCCS), as well as client relations at a landmark business hub (Hilite Business Park).

Known as a quick learner and a proactive team player, I am familiar with modern HR practices, marketing strategies, and customer service approaches. I am currently seeking entry-level roles or internship opportunities where I can contribute meaningfully while continuing my professional growth and learning.
